journal: Regime read as transitional: SPY holds its long-term uptrend (above sma20/50/200) but 20d change is -1.25%, a short-term pullback. Macro page (live, not session-scoped -- see caveat note) showed broad Greed reading, sector rotation into financials/energy visible in movers. Screened watchlist: XLF confirmed uptrend across three timeframes with strong 20d momentum (+9.34%), bought as conviction leg. QQQ (-4.2% 20d, below sma20) and XLE (-9.35% 20d, below all SMAs) both failed the two-timeframe confirmation test and were passed on. SPY bought smaller as the core index leg despite the short-term pullback, since sma50/sma200 still confirm the primary trend. Checked /ticker/XLF decision table before buying: RSI(14) Oversold rated SUGGESTIVE, price_above_sma200 FIRING but INSUFFICIENT significance -- useful context, though I noted the sample window runs through 2026-08-14, well past today's session date, so these significance stats are not session-scoped (flagging in journal, not filing separately -- same root cause as the documented pricing-postdate caveat). Portfolio page after fill showed both positions with as-of stamps and weight-of-invested percentages; cash and equity both rendered cleanly at ,545.98 / 0,013.44.

Regime unchanged: transitional. XLF held, still the strongest name on the watchlist (20d +7.57%, above all SMAs). QQQ crossed back above its own sma20 this session after being below it on session 1 -- added a small confirming position since sma50/sma200 remained supportive throughout. XLE stayed below every SMA (20d -9.57%) and was not touched. No sells this session; watching QQQ and SPY closely since both are still digesting a short-term pullback even though the primary trend holds. Noted the /tax page's default-year defect filed in session 1 -- re-checked briefly, still defaults to 2025 with no persistence of my earlier year selection, consistent with what was filed.

Sold the full QQQ position -- 2 shares at 704.60, entry 714.53 -- on the stop/invalidation triggered together on 2026-07-07's close (709.43, below both sma20 720.43 and my 715.00 stop). Small realized loss expected, roughly -0 net of the /usr/bin/bash.04 sell fee. Held SPY and XLF unchanged; XLF's uptrend is intact though it gave back some of the week's gains today. Going to the tax page next session to check how the disposal, lot basis and any wash-sale exposure are presented, since I bought QQQ again... no, I did not rebuy QQQ this session, so no wash-sale should apply to this specific loss unless a future buy inside 30 days triggers one -- worth watching if I reconsider QQQ before 2026-08-06.

Added 1 share of SPY, bringing it to 3 shares (~22.6 percent weight), on the basis that the primary uptrend remains intact across all three SMAs and 20d change turned positive again. Passed on QQQ (now below both sma20 and sma50 -- glad I stopped out earlier) and XLE (bounced but still below sma50, one timeframe short of my confirmation bar). Held XLF unchanged rather than add, since a slippage-adjusted fill risked landing at or over the 25 percent single-name cap -- decided the mandate boundary was not worth testing with a marginal add. Book now 2 positions, SPY and XLF, cash roughly 58 percent of equity -- deliberately conservative given no third confirmed name has emerged this week outside my two winners.

Final session of the week. Rebought QQQ (2 sh at 721.06) now that it has reclaimed all three SMAs -- deliberately inside the wash-sale window from the session-3 loss sale, to see whether the tax page's per-ticker panel actually updates the deferred amount and window status once a real wash-sale event exists rather than the empty case I checked in session 3. Held SPY and XLF unchanged; both remain in confirmed uptrends. Week ends with 3 open positions (QQQ, SPY, XLF), equity 10,001.96 against a 10,000.00 start -- roughly flat, unsurprising for a conservative week that spent more time confirming trends than chasing them. Heading to /tax next to check the wash-sale panel post-fill before finalizing.
